usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts and orders, and Flowlu receives follow-up work through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Task” in Flowlu
bestTemplate.why: A task for each abandoned checkout gives someone the customer's email or phone to follow up on.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so its “Create Task” runs after a scheduled check.
